facts.fact: Justice Sans Frontière states that law no. 2025-15 of 4 September 2025 created the National Commission for Access to Information (CONAI), with an implementing decree no. 2025-1837 in application.
Justice Sans Frontière cites implementing decree no. 2025-1837, article 33, made under the access to information law, which requires prior referral to CONAI before any court appeal.

Justice Sans Frontière says the Supreme Court, by ordinance no. 11/2026 of 16 April 2026, rejected a lawyer's request for the amount of the secret funds on the sole procedural ground that CONAI had not been seized first.
